name: koovo-review-workbench
description: Accounting Data Review Workbench - Koovo take-home assessment

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend run test:run
scripts.test:backend: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
